return [{ json: { ...$json, queryText: `WITH summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions,
    COALESCE(SUM(users), 0)::int AS users,
    COALESCE(SUM(new_users), 0)::int AS new_users,
    COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::int AS engaged_sessions,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4)
      ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(engaged_sessions), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 4)
    END AS engagement_rate,
    COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::int AS gsc_clicks,
    COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0)::int AS gsc_impressions,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4)
      ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_clicks), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(gsc_impressions), 0), 4)
    END AS gsc_ctr,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) = 0 THEN 0::numeric(10,4)
      ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gsc_position), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
    END AS gsc_position,
    COALESCE(SUM(contacts_created), 0)::int AS contacts_created,
    COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions,
    COALESCE(SUM(opportunities_created), 0)::int AS opportunities_created,
    COALESCE(SUM(meetings_booked), 0)::int AS meetings_booked,
    COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_count), 0)::int AS closed_won_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(closed_lost_count), 0)::int AS closed_lost_count
  FROM report_daily_summary
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
channels AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.sessions DESC), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      channel,
      traffic_source,
      source,
      medium,
      SUM(sessions)::int AS sessions,
      SUM(users)::int AS users,
      SUM(new_users)::int AS new_users,
      SUM(leads)::int AS leads,
      SUM(opportunities)::int AS opportunities,
      COALESCE(SUM(closed_won_revenue), 0)::numeric(18,2) AS closed_won_revenue
    FROM report_channel_daily_summary
    WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    GROUP BY channel, traffic_source, source, medium
    ORDER BY SUM(sessions) DESC
    LIMIT 8
  ) t
),
stage_daily AS (
  SELECT
    x.report_date,
    x.pipeline,
    x.stage,
    x.stage_count,
    GREATEST(x.stage_count - COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0), 0)::int AS moved_in_count,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(x.prev_stage_count, 0) - x.stage_count, 0)::int AS moved_out_count,
    x.won_count,
    x.lost_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      report_date,
      pipeline,
      stage,
      stage_count,
      won_count,
      lost_count,
      LAG(stage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY report_date) AS prev_stage_count
    FROM report_stage_daily_summary
    WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
  ) x
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      pipeline,
      SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count,
      SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count,
      SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count,
      SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count,
      SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count
    FROM stage_daily
    GROUP BY pipeline
    ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC
  ) t
),
stages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.moved_out_count DESC, t.stage_count DESC), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      pipeline,
      stage,
      SUM(stage_count)::int AS stage_count,
      SUM(moved_in_count)::int AS moved_in_count,
      SUM(moved_out_count)::int AS moved_out_count,
      SUM(won_count)::int AS won_count,
      SUM(lost_count)::int AS lost_count
    FROM stage_daily
    GROUP BY pipeline, stage
    ORDER BY SUM(moved_out_count) DESC, SUM(stage_count) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
),
health AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.source_system), '[]'::json) AS items
  FROM (
    SELECT source_system, status, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_row_count, stale_after_hours, last_error
    FROM report_source_health
    WHERE source_system <> 'undefined'
    ORDER BY source_system
  ) t
),
landing_pages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0)::int AS item_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(sessions), 0)::int AS sessions,
         COALESCE(SUM(form_submissions), 0)::int AS form_submissions
  FROM report_landing_page_daily_summary
  WHERE report_date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
),
summary_json AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'traffic', CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM summary) > 0 THEN (SELECT sessions FROM summary)::text ELSE 'GA4 pending' END,
    'leads', (SELECT contacts_created FROM summary)::text,
    'sales', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM summary)::text,
    'trafficNumeric', (SELECT sessions FROM summary),
    'leadsNumeric', (SELECT contacts_created FROM summary),
    'salesNumeric', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM summary),
    'closedWonRevenue', (SELECT closed_won_revenue FROM summary),
    'users', (SELECT users FROM summary),
    'newUsers', (SELECT new_users FROM summary),
    'engagedSessions', (SELECT engaged_sessions FROM summary),
    'engagementRate', (SELECT engagement_rate FROM summary),
    'gscClicks', (SELECT gsc_clicks FROM summary),
    'gscImpressions', (SELECT gsc_impressions FROM summary),
    'gscCtr', (SELECT gsc_ctr FROM summary),
    'gscPosition', (SELECT gsc_position FROM summary),
    'contactsCreated', (SELECT contacts_created FROM summary),
    'formSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM summary),
    'opportunitiesCreated', (SELECT opportunities_created FROM summary),
    'meetingsBooked', (SELECT meetings_booked FROM summary),
    'closedWonCount', (SELECT closed_won_count FROM summary),
    'closedLostCount', (SELECT closed_lost_count FROM summary),
    'trafficGapLandingPages', (SELECT item_count FROM landing_pages),
    'trafficGapSessions', (SELECT sessions FROM landing_pages),
    'trafficGapFormSubmissions', (SELECT form_submissions FROM landing_pages)
  ) AS payload
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'window', json_build_object(
    'from', $1::date,
    'to', $2::date
  ),
  'summary', (SELECT to_jsonb(summary_json.payload) FROM summary_json),
  'channelBreakdown', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM channels), '[]'::json),
  'pipelineDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM pipelines), '[]'::json),
  'stageDropoff', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM stages), '[]'::json),
  'health', COALESCE((SELECT items FROM health), '[]'::json)
) AS payload;` } }];
